mapper.select: select e.event_id, e.package_id, e.document_id, e.event_type, e.operator_user_id, e.operator_name, case when e.operator_role = 'SYSTEM' then '系统' else coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), e.operator_name) end as operator_display_name, e.operator_role, e.ip_address, e.user_agent, e.event_payload, e.document_hash, e.prev_event_hash, e.event_hash, e.request_id, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.remark from oa_sign_event e left join sys_user u on u.user_id = e.operator_user_id where e.package_id = #{packageId} order by e.event_id asc
select event_hash from oa_sign_event where package_id = #{packageId} order by event_id desc limit 1

select event_id, package_id, document_id, event_type, operator_user_id, operator_name, operator_role, ip_address, user_agent, event_payload, document_hash, prev_event_hash, event_hash, request_id, create_by, create_time, remark from oa_sign_event where event_type = #{eventType} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
